objective: Make the root-rules session marker safe and per user so the late-delivery hook never fails on every call or follows a symlink.
scope: Worktree /home/user/holyagent-root (head 673c38a). Reviews: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/e4ac10e5-b710-572b-aa70-34045c8c8d11/scratchpad/r-assignment-0mvtm1tfc-a04n.txt (code, blocker B1) and /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/e4ac10e5-b710-572b-aa70-34045c8c8d11/scratchpad/r-assignment-0mvtm1tnb-sg3e.txt (security findings 1 and 2).

Fix in packages/runtime/src/state/delivery.ts and its callers: (1) scope the marker folder per user (for example os.tmpdir()/holyagent-sessions-<uid>, or the user name where process.getuid is missing on Windows), created with mode 0700; check with lstat that it is a real directory owned by the current user, and treat anything else as unavailable; (2) open markers with 'wx' in markRulesDelivered too and treat EEXIST as success, so no write follows a symlink; (3) when the marker folder is unavailable or unwritable, root-rules exits 0 with no output (degrade quietly, never a per-call error), and update the test that asserts exit 1 accordingly.
Optional while here, only if small: replace the replaceAll string replacer for CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT in hook.ts with a function replacer.
constraints: Work only in that worktree; make no version-control writes and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/. Finish with mise run build and mise run verify.
When done and checked, stop and report; no unrequested changes.

criteria.text: The marker folder is per user, mode 0700 and owner-checked, markers never follow symlinks, and an unusable folder makes root-rules exit 0 silently, each with a test that fails without the fix
